_about: Which picture each page uses. A page that holds a film subtitle uses that subtitle's clean film frame (cue/NN, automatic). Pages without a subtitle take, chapter by chapter, the pictures listed here in order (img = file under out/book_img without .png; fx/fy = centre of the part to show 0-1; z = zoom; cap = small caption; alt = description for screen readers).

cover.alt: The Lighthouse Light: two children, a small robot and a reindeer walk down a snowy hill towards a bay where a lighthouse sends out a golden beam

end.alt: Hazel's dark bedroom at night; through the window the lighthouse beam sweeps across the sky
